name: qkd_static_kv_landing_lane_h2-h2-COMMIT
purpose: KVCTRL 1815 (lead Q-KV 2026-10-16): structural variant of qkd_static_kv_landing_seg. The flat ls5 tile (151.2 x 1,512 um) is 9 % utilised and its ONE ck root measured 722..753 ps TT insertion over 1,512 um (9,492 sinks): even a CLOSED flat view fails native launch (<= 220 ps). qkd_static_kv_landing_seg_h = wires-only parent of hardened children with short local roots: 4 x qkd_static_kv_landing_lane (one master: landing PC + SRAM + that PC's 256-b response data pipe, at the PC pitch; lanes 2/3 mirrored), qkd_static_kv_landing_row (rowctl DATA 0 + near-branch hops 1/2) at the centre, 2 x qkd_static_kv_landing_relay (far-branch 0/3 hops, half way). Same registers, same edges: cycle-identical to the flat seg (latency 8); cycles_added 0. Bench = the flat seg bench with seg_h as DUT (run_landing_seg_h.sh) + the flat bench logs compared. Lane = one landing PC: E face = its return-slot word (actual_*/expected_*), W face = its 256-b rsp_data lane, N face = row/relay seam + arm/epoch/layer/cfg/reset/clock; placed 4 x (lanes 2/3 MX so N faces the centre). h2: lane h1 gate measured TT insertion 168.5..231.9 (spread 63.4) with logic in W/E pin bands + an N cluster and an empty S half (103.68 tall, 36% util): compact to 140.4 x 88.56 with the SRAM low (>= 20 um from every core edge), so the clock tree spans less.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_static_kv_landing_lane u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_20261014/qkd_static_kv_landing_seg_h.sv rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_20261014/qkd_static_kv_landing.sv rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_20261014/qkd_static_kv_hop.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: landing_seg_h_exact
bench.note: tb_static_landing PHYS=1 with qkd_static_kv_landing_seg_h as DUT (all lane/relay clock entries on the TB clock): 32 segments x 4 PCs, K CTX 1000/2048/4096/8192 + PV16 V; fault modes 1-5 and the aliasing ordinal must FAIL

bench.name: landing_seg_h_mutant
bench.note: lane 0 response data hop flips a data bit (HOP_MUT 1)
